986.text:
986 asmad base of obl. cases plur. of 1st pers. pronoun asmā́n , asmā́bhiḥ , asmábhyam , asmā́kam , asmā́su , dat. loc. asmḗ . Pa. nom. acc. amhē (- ē after other pronouns), gen. amhākaṁ , inst. amhēhi ; Aś. dh. acc. aphe , gen. aphākaṁ ,
loc. aphesu ; NiDoc. gen. asmakaṁ , inst. asmehi ; Pk.
nom. acc. amhē , gen. amhāṇaṁ , inst. amhēhiṁ . The Kaf. and Dard. forms are discussed in detail by
Morgenstierne IL v 357 ff.: Ash. ima 'we', Kt. emo , Wg. amī́ , Pr. asẽ ; Dm. obl. amâ , mâ ; Tir. mā 'we', Paš. hamā́ ,
Shum. ābə (< * ambhē ), gen. amana (←Paš.); Woṭ. mā acc.
pl.; Gaw. amō̃ 'we'; Kal. dir. ābi , obl. hamā ; Kho. dir. and
obl. ispa ; Tor. nom. mō , inst. mahī , gen. amun , mun ; Mai.
gen. zā̃ , Chil. azā̃ , Gau. asā̃ , Phal. asī , Sh. ăsĕi , gur. ăsō̃ . In the remaining languages the declension rests
mainly on three MIA. forms: — * asmē , * asmānaṁ ,
* asmēhi with a tendency in the mod. stage for the successors
of * asmē to be replaced by the inst. (as often in
the case of 1st pers. sg. see ahám ): Gy. eur. ame , pal. ắme , as. emi ; Ḍ. Λmέ , gen. ama ; K. ȧsⁱ , gen. sônᵘ , S. asī˜ (< * asmēhiṁ ), obl. asā̃ ; L. asã : asã ; P. asī˜ : asā̃ ; WPah. as : asan ~ jaun. ām ; OB. ambhe , āmhe (Chatterji ODBL
809), āmi : āmā ; Or. āmbhe , āme , ami : āmbha ; Mth. Bhoj.
Aw. H. dir. and obl. ham ; OG. āma , mod. ame , M. āmhī ,
Ko. āmī (these three orig. inst.); Si. äp < apphe , apa < apphākaṁ (Geiger EGS 8 wrongly < ātmán -). asmā́ka -. Addenda: asmad-: Kho. ispā́ 'we' BKhoT 68, S.kcch. asī˜ dir.
'we', obl. asā̃ -, Garh. ham dir. and obl., A. āmi .
